text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O had a good run, but... 
doesn't she look totally exhausted? She's 
completely out of breath.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Her speed was truly formidable. However, 
1600m might have been too long for her.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Haaah......... *cough*, *cough-hack*!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...As expected of a GⅠ, the level of 
competition is so high.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Prevailing through this won't be easy... I 
must prepare myself as well.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: *Wheeze*... *pant*... *pant*...
choice_data_list: A-Are you okay...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O returned to the waiting 
room still struggling to catch her breath. 
She was utterly exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I'm... so sorry... I lacked stamina... I 
was nowhere close to the ideal run I 
envisioned...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Faster! I've still got more in me! Top 
speeeeed—GRAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O went all-out from start 
to finish. Aiming to reach top speed, she 
never held back for even a fraction of a 
second.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
But perhaps that's just the way it has to 
be. You can't reach top speed if you slow 
down.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's common for things done in training to 
fall apart in a race. She, too, is likely 
incapable of easing her pace during a real 
race.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"It's so frustrating... I feel so 
pathetic, it's so frustrating!! Trainer, 
I'm so frustrated!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Next time... Next time, I need even more 
speed! What should I do!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The light in her eyes hasn't died. Focused 
solely on the goal of top speed, her 
fighting spirit burns with a fierce 
intensity.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I must not give a platitude in response.
choice_data_list:
Let's head back to the academy and look 
into it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day, we decided to reassess 
Calstone Light O's current condition. 
First, we'll try identifying the key 
challenges.
choice_data_list:
Let's check out your running firsthand in 
the VR Umalator.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The virtual reality device, the "VR 
Umalator." It is a simulator capable of 
recreating various racecourses, weather 
conditions, and more.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
The Umulator! I see, so this is what we'll 
be using.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If you recreate a race in the Umulator, 
you can view it from all 360 degrees. It 
also makes checking the turf and the 
condition of the umamusume easy.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Let's make sure to thoroughly identify the 
issues.
choice_data_list: Well then, shall we head inside?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Listening to her report, I look back on 
the Asahi Hai FS.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
...My legs began to slow around here. They 
suddenly felt as heavy as lead.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If the feel of the race was that 
different, I have to say the 1,600m will 
be tough.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right now, it's doubtful whether she can 
even hold out for 1,200 meters...
choice_data_list:
Let's watch the most recent practice race 
too.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
This one looks more stable... Hmm. Three 
strides out of the gate, her body sways 
side to side. It's not like she's doing 
side-to-side hops or something.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Did I really drift that wide on the turn? 
Failing to take the curve and decelerating 
here... terrible. I'm awful at both 
decelerating and accelerating.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Reviewing the race made the issues clear. 
Lack of stamina, course positioning during 
cornering, adapting to race 
developments... The list of challenges is 
endless.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The question is which task to tackle 
first.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her body is also still developing. If we 
mess up the order of our approach, she 
won't win her races and might miss the 
conditions for graded stakes.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Hmph. I am not particularly versatile. 
Adapting to race developments will likely 
prove difficult. It will take quite some 
time, I imagine."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
However, I can become faster. Fast enough 
to make any obstacles irrelevant.
choice_data_list:
So you're going to make up for all the 
negatives with sheer speed?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Of course, that too is difficult. It 
would be impossible with anything less 
than extraordinary speed.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
However, if I want to reach top speed, I 
have to pull off at least that much!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She certainly shows potential. Her 
exceptional speed is a powerful weapon. 
But..."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I beg of you, Trainer. I want to surpass 
everything with pure speed!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
If it's for that purpose, I can endure any 
training!

...Fufu, what an earnest girl. Just like a 
single ray of light cutting through the 
night.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vision is enveloped in light. The dazzling 
brilliance recedes in an instant, and in 
that fleeting moment, the virtual space 
transforms into an entirely different 
landscape.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And right before my eyes stood three 
Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry to interrupt. But you seemed 
troubled, so we wondered if there was any 
way we could help.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
After hearing such a passionate plea, 
there's no way we could just sit still and 
do nothing.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
O Umamusume who marches forward without 
shying from hardship. We shall serve as an 
aid to pave that path.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text: If that is what you desire, of course.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Darley Arabian, Byerley Turk, and 
Godolphin Barb. AI granted personhood, 
taking the form of the Three Goddesses.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inside this Umalator, they can sometimes 
offer advice to the Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
The Three Goddesses? Why? Are they bored? 
Or is this a promotional stunt for the 
Umalator?

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text: Neither. What on earth do you take us for?

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
You see, I was drawn to it. To your 
passion—your desire to run faster than 
anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
"Faster than anyone. Faster than anything. 
I want to reach an unknown speed..."

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
It is a wish harbored by countless 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
From the very beginning down to this day. 
It is the universal dream that all 
Umamusume have envisioned, after all.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
In other words, you want to piggyback on 
my dream. And that's why you're helping 
me.
choice_data_list: Watch how you say it!

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, ufufu! What an interesting girl. I 
wonder who influenced her.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Godolphin seems to get along with 
them quite well.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Right. Compatibility between us and the 
Umamusume is crucial for support too. 
Looks like it's best to leave it to 
Godolphin this time.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'd love to do that. What do you 
think, Trainer?
choice_data_list:
If you're willing to give feedback, please 
do.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The objective view of a third party is 
useful. When one hits a wall in thinking, 
one's perspective tends to narrow. Her 
input will surely prevent that.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Shall we change locations, 
then?

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
You were having trouble deciding the order 
to address your tasks, weren't you, 
Trainer? In that case, how about we assess 
the current situation in detail?

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Training methods and optimal paths vary 
for every Umamusume. Let's ponder over it 
carefully and find what's best.
choice_data_list: Then... Light O, let's do a run at 1,400m.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Understood.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
"I got the footage. I'll transfer the data 
to your tablet."
choice_data_list: Light O, are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*...! Yes.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
My legs feel totally fine, so please don't 
worry. I can still run!
choice_data_list: First, let's get some proper rest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even with fatigue from the race still 
lingering, Calstone Light O ran the full 
1400m without easing up at all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I can endure any kind of training"— True 
to those words, she tackles it with a 
positive attitude.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All so she can run at absolute top speed. 
With relentless, single-minded 
determination, she pushes ever forward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So that her efforts are rewarded. I want 
to guide her toward her future.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I review the footage of the 1,400m run 
from earlier. Though her form slipped 
toward the end, it didn't completely fall 
apart like it did in the 1,600m.
choice_data_list: A mile might be a bit long for you.
A mile might be a bit long for you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's not like she can't win at the mile. 
If she figures out how to run to win at 
the mile, she should be able to do it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet that is fundamentally different from 
running in pursuit of top speed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To reach top speed, it has to be a running 
style specialized purely in speed—
choice_data_list:
Why not drop the mile and focus on 
sprints?

How about dropping the mile and focusing 
on sprints?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
—And that is how top speed is achieved, 
correct?
choice_data_list:
Yeah. Though the races you can enter will 
be fewer.

Yeah. Even though it'll mean fewer races 
we can enter.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her optimal distance is likely around 
1,000 meters. However, since races at that 
distance are few and far between, she 
needs to expand her distance versatility.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
1,600m is tough, but at sprint distances, 
we can forge a path to winning a GⅠ.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, if you are aiming for top 
speed, it would be best to proceed with 
winning at 1200m in mind.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"I don't mind. My goal is to be fast, 
simply fast—that's all!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Please, Trainer! Guide me to the speed of 
light!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She wants to run at top speed, even if it 
means throwing everything else away. I 
could feel her mad passion pouring out 
through her words.
choice_data_list:
Got it. Let's tackle those assignments 
with speed, too!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
!! Yes! I look forward to working with 
you!

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Which means your next target race is a 
sprint, right?
choice_data_list: I think we should go with the Aoi Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: Kyoto Racecourse, clockwise 1200m, right?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's just right for me. Look at 
that, there are races I can enter.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"You shouldn't hold back, you know. Were 
you hoping I'd praise you?"
choice_data_list: No! It's my job to help you win!
No! It's my job to help you win!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I know. You worked hard. Good job, 
good job.
choice_data_list: Kuh, what are these mixed feelings...!

Kuh, what is with this complicated 
feeling...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I'll thank you with my running. At the Aoi 
Stakes!
